name: Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī ibn Ḥāzim al-Liḥyānī
summary: Kufan lexicographer, author of a book of Nawādir, who knew more of the rarities of al-Kisāʾī, al-Farrāʾ and al-Aḥmar than anyone, by Salama's account.
bio: Ibn al-Anbārī calls al-Liḥyānī one of the great masters of the lexicon and names his book of Nawādir ('rarities'); Salama said that no one knew more of the rarities from al-Kisāʾī, al-Farrāʾ and al-Aḥmar. Some of the rare usages he reported from the Arabs are cited in the entry.
Al-Zubaydī counts him in the second generation of the lexicographers of Kufa. The year of his death is not recorded.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 235–237
